title: corn
entry: Corn is a plant that people grow in fields. It is also the food we eat from that plant. A corn plant can grow taller than a grown-up. The leaves are long and thin and green. At the top, the plant has a tassel that looks like a little brush. The corn we eat sits on a cob. The cob is the hard middle part. Yellow kernels cover the cob in rows. Each kernel is a seed. A cob can have about 800 kernels. Green husks wrap around the cob like a coat. The husks keep bugs away. Corn plants need sun and water to grow. Farmers plant corn seeds in spring. The seeds sprout in about one week. The plants grow fast in warm weather. People pick corn in late summer. Some corn is sweet, and people boil it and eat it. Some corn is hard, and people grind it into flour. Flour from corn is used to make bread and chips. Corn is also fed to cows and chickens. Some corn is made into fuel for cars. Corn grows in many countries. The United States grows more corn than any other country. A corn plant has roots that hold it in the ground. The roots take in water from the soil. Birds and bugs sometimes eat the kernels. A single kernel can grow into a whole new plant.

title: honeydew
entry: Honeydew is a sweet, sticky liquid. It is made by tiny bugs called aphids. Aphids drink sap from plants. Their bodies turn the sap into honeydew. The aphids drip the honeydew onto leaves. Honeydew looks like small, clear drops. It feels sticky like glue. Ants love to eat honeydew. Ants often crawl on plants to find it. Some ants tap aphids to make them drip honeydew. The ants drink the sweet drops. This helps the ants get food. Honeydew can fall on cars parked under trees. The drops make the car sticky and shiny. Bees also collect honeydew. They turn it into a dark, strong honey. People can eat this honey. It tastes a little like molasses. Honeydew can grow a black, sooty mold. The mold makes leaves look dirty. Wasps like honeydew too. They come to plants to lick it up. Ladybugs eat honeydew as a snack. Honeydew is very small in size. One drop is tiny. A single aphid can make many drops in a day. Honeydew is not the same as the melon. The honeydew melon is a fruit. It is green and sweet inside. The melon grows on a vine. It is big and round. People slice the melon and eat it. The melon has small seeds in the middle. Honeydew the liquid and honeydew the melon share a name. Their name sounds the same. But they are very different things.

title: bookkeeper
entry: A bookkeeper is a person who keeps track of money for a business. A bookkeeper writes down money that comes in. A bookkeeper also writes down money that goes out. This helps the owner know how much money the business has. A bookkeeper uses a computer or a paper book to do this. The paper book is called a ledger. A ledger has rows and rows of numbers. Each row tells about one payment or one sale. A bookkeeper checks the numbers to make sure they are right. If a number is wrong, the bookkeeper fixes it. A bookkeeper does this work every day or every week. Many small shops have one bookkeeper. Big companies may have a whole team of bookkeepers. A bookkeeper does not decide how to spend the money. The owner makes that choice. A bookkeeper must be good with numbers and careful. A bookkeeper often works at a desk in an office. Some bookkeepers work from home. A bookkeeper can help with taxes too. Taxes are money people pay to the government. A bookkeeper sorts papers like bills and receipts. A receipt shows that someone paid for something. A bookkeeper keeps these papers safe and in order. This makes it easy to find them later.

title: tulip
entry: A tulip is a flower that grows from a bulb. The bulb looks like a small brown onion. It sits under the ground. In spring, a green stem pushes up from the bulb. Long green leaves grow on the stem too. At the top, a flower opens. Tulips come in many colors. You can find red, yellow, pink, white, and purple ones. Some tulips are almost black. Each flower has about six soft petals. The petals make a cup shape. Inside the cup are tiny seeds. A tulip flower can be as tall as a ruler. Some are even taller. People plant tulips in gardens and parks. They plant the bulbs in the fall. Then the bulbs sleep all winter. When spring comes, the stems grow fast. One bulb can make one flower. Some kinds make two or three. Tulips open their petals wide on sunny days. At night, the petals close up again. Bees visit tulips to look for sweet juice. The wind can carry the light seeds away. After the flower dies, the leaves turn yellow. Then people dig up the bulbs. The bulbs can be kept and planted again next year. The Netherlands is famous for its tulips. Every spring, big fields there are full of color. People come from far away to see them. Tulips do not smell very strong. Most have only a light smell. A tulip is not a rose. It has no sharp thorns on its stem. You can pick a tulip and put it in a glass of water. It will stay pretty for a few days.

title: toad
entry: A toad is a small animal with soft, bumpy skin. It is a kind of frog, but its skin is drier. A toad has short legs and a wide body. It has big eyes on top of its head. A toad can be brown, gray, or green. Its skin has lots of little bumps and spots. A toad lives on land most of the time. It likes gardens, woods, and fields. It hides under rocks, logs, and leaves. A toad sleeps during the day and looks for food at night. It eats bugs, worms, and slugs. It catches food with its long, sticky tongue. A toad has no teeth, so it swallows food whole. A toad can puff up its body to look bigger. This helps it scare away other animals. A toad has poison on its skin to keep enemies away. The poison is only on the bumps behind its eyes. A toad can make a loud croaking sound. The sound can be heard far away. A toad lays eggs in water. The eggs are small and round. They are covered in jelly. A baby toad hatches as a tadpole. A tadpole has a tail and lives in the water. It breathes with gills, like a fish. As it grows, it loses its tail and grows legs. Then it can hop onto land. A toad can live for many years. Some toads live more than ten years. A toad sheds its skin as it grows. It pulls the old skin off with its mouth. A toad can jump about 20 times its own body length. A toad does not drink water with its mouth. It takes in water through its skin. On cold days, a toad digs a hole and sleeps in it. It can sleep for many months.

title: june beetle

It can fly and make a loud buzz. June beetles come out in late spring. They fly at night. They are drawn to lights. A June beetle eats leaves. It eats the leaves of trees and bushes. Its mouth is made for chewing. Baby June beetles live in the ground. They are white and soft. They eat the roots of grass and plants. They stay in the soil for one to three years. Then they come out as adult beetles. Adult June beetles live for only a few weeks. They mate and the female lays eggs. A female can lay about 50 eggs. Birds and raccoons eat June beetles. People often see them on porches in May and June. Some people call them May beetles. A June beetle is about one inch long. It can be a pest to lawns and gardens.

title: sushi
entry: Sushi is a food from Japan. It is made of cooked rice and other things. The rice is mixed with a little vinegar. Vinegar makes the rice taste a bit sour. Sushi often has fish on top. The fish is usually raw. Raw means the fish is not cooked. Some sushi has cooked fish instead. Some sushi has cooked shrimp or crab. Sushi can also have cucumber or avocado inside. A small roll of sushi is called a maki. Maki is rice and fillings rolled in a sheet of seaweed. Seaweed is a green plant from the sea. The seaweed is thin and dark green. It wraps around the rice like a belt. A sushi chef makes sushi by hand. The chef shapes the rice into small balls. This takes many years to learn. Sushi is often eaten with soy sauce. Soy sauce is a salty brown liquid. Sushi is also eaten with green wasabi. Wasabi is very hot and spicy. People eat sushi with chopsticks. Some people eat it with their fingers. Sushi is often served on a small wooden board. Some sushi comes on a moving belt. The belt carries small plates of sushi to people. People take the plates they want. Sushi is eaten all over the world now. In Japan, sushi is a popular food. There are many kinds of sushi. Some are big and some are small. One common kind is the California roll. It has crab and avocado inside. Another kind is the salmon roll. Salmon is a pink fish. Sushi is usually eaten fresh. It should not sit out for a long time. Many sushi shops make the sushi right in front of you.

title: constellation
entry: A constellation is a group of stars. People long ago drew pictures with these stars. They joined the stars with pretend lines. The lines make shapes like animals or people. A constellation is not close together in space. Its stars can be very far apart. They only look near each other from Earth. Earth is the planet where we live. People gave each constellation a name. There are 88 constellations in the sky. The Big Dipper is a famous group of seven stars. It looks like a big spoon or a ladle. You can see the Big Dipper on a clear night. It is easy to find in the northern sky. Orion is another famous constellation. It looks like a hunter holding a shield. Three bright stars make Orion's belt. You can see Orion's belt on winter nights. The stars in a constellation do not move together. Each star moves its own way through space. Over a very long time, the shapes change. Stars are huge balls of hot, bright gas. Our Sun is a star too. The Sun looks big because it is close to us. Other stars look tiny because they are so far away. Some constellations are best seen in summer. Some are best seen in winter. The sky looks different in each season. That is because Earth moves around the Sun. Long ago, people used constellations like a map. They helped people find their way at night. Farmers used them to know when to plant crops. Today, constellations still help people find stars. People also use them to name parts of the sky. A constellation is a helpful picture in the night sky.

entry: A lifeguard is a person who keeps people safe in the water. Lifeguards watch swimmers at pools and at beaches. They sit high up on a tall chair so they can see far. A panda is about as tall as a grown-up person. It can weigh more than 100 kilograms. Pandas live in mountain forests with lots of bamboo. Bamboo is a tall plant with hard stems. Pandas eat bamboo almost all day long. They eat for up to 14 hours a day. A panda has strong jaws to crush bamboo. It also has a special wrist bone that works like a thumb. This helps it hold bamboo stems. Pandas spend most of their time on the ground. They are good at climbing trees too. A mother panda gives birth to one or two tiny babies. A new baby panda is pink and has almost no fur. It is about the size of a stick of butter. The baby stays with its mother for about a year and a half. Pandas do not sleep all winter like other bears. They stay awake and keep eating. Pandas are very quiet animals. They make a few soft sounds but do not roar. Wild pandas are rare, so people work to protect them.

entry: A seed is a small thing that can grow into a plant. Every seed holds a baby plant inside it. The baby plant has tiny leaves and a tiny root. A seed also holds food for the baby plant. entry: A maggot is a baby fly. It looks like a tiny white worm. It has no legs and no wings. Its body is soft and squishy. A maggot is very small. Most are about as long as a grain of rice. A maggot comes out of an egg. A mother fly lays her eggs on food that is old. She lays many eggs at once. A fly can lay more than one hundred eggs. The eggs hatch in about one day. Then the maggots crawl out. Maggots eat and eat. They eat old food and dead things. They help clean up the world this way. A maggot moves by twisting its body. It moves slowly. It likes dark places. It hides away from the sun. A maggot grows fast. Its skin does not grow with it. So it sheds its skin. It does this many times. After some days, a maggot stops eating. It becomes hard and brown. This hard case is called a pupa. Inside it, the maggot changes. It turns into a fly. This takes about a week. Then the case opens. A new fly comes out. The fly has wings and can fly. It looks for food and a mate. Then it lays eggs, and the circle starts again. Some maggots live in fruit. They can be pests for farmers. Birds and ants eat maggots. Some people use maggots as fish bait. Maggots do not bite people. They cannot sting. They do not have a mouth like ours. They have tiny hooks to help them eat. That is how a maggot lives and grows.

entry: A pickup is a small truck. It has a cab in the front. People sit in the cab. It has an open box in the back. The box is called a bed. The bed has low walls on three sides. The back wall can fold down. Then the bed is open at the back. People put things in the bed. They carry wood, boxes, or bikes. A pickup can carry heavy loads. Many pickups have four doors. entry: A stork is a big bird. It has long legs and a long beak. It has a long neck too. A stork has big wings. Its wings are wide and strong. Some storks are white and black. Some storks are mostly grey. A stork can be as tall as a grown-up person. A stork lives in many parts of the world. It likes places with water and grass. It looks for food in wet fields. A stork eats frogs and fish. It eats bugs and small mice too. A stork uses its long beak to catch food. It walks slowly in the water. Then it grabs food fast. A stork makes a big nest. The nest is made of sticks. The nest sits high on a roof or a pole. A stork comes back to the same nest each year. It adds more sticks to the nest. A mother stork lays eggs in the nest. She lays about four eggs. The eggs are white. The mother and father sit on the eggs. They keep the eggs warm. Baby storks hatch from the eggs. The babies are small and weak at first. Both parents bring food to the babies. The babies grow and grow. Soon they can stand in the nest. Then they learn to fly. A stork flies with its neck stretched out. It flaps its big wings slowly. A stork can fly for a long time. Many storks fly to warm places in winter. They fly in big groups. They go where the food is. In spring they fly back home. A stork claps its beak to make a sound. It makes a loud clicking noise. People often put a wagon wheel on a roof. A stork may build its nest on the wheel. People like having a stork nest nearby. They think it brings good luck.
